content.short: Altura offers stablecoin deposits earning yield sourced from onchain strategies.
content.description: Altura takes stablecoin deposits and routes them into yield strategies on Hyperliquid, presenting a single deposit rather than a set of positions to manage. Products framed this simply live or die on where the yield actually comes from, which is the question worth asking before the headline rate.
